input.heading: 2023 or newer Teslas, lowest price first

steps.text: There are 780 Teslas from 2023 or newer. I checked the first page of 24 results, which came back in popularity order. I then picked 12 of the 24 and ordered them from lowest to highest price. The two cheapest, the Model 3s at $21,990 and $25,590, have 95,732 and 90,317 miles. I can check delivery dates, narrow by Model 3 or Model Y, or look at more pages.
